data_expense.excluded_costs: Usertime, computing and agenttoken usage are not priced as a cash data purchase; no live broker costs incurred. Trade costs are separately simulated.

items.basis: cumulative provider quotes for executed requests; not invoice reconciliation

data_expense.scope: Entire dedicated study acquisition quote, including PTN repair samples and full histories; charged once at accountstart in a separate simulation.

metadata.expense_treatment: Separate initial-expense account reruns; no terminal subtraction.
metadata.interpretation: Passing is exploratory evidence, not funding approval. Unknown measures stay null.
metadata.outcome_filtering: None; exact independent dates and all required accounts are retained.
